assumptions: This market's existence/name ("bangkok") — inferred from the task prompt only, not from any prior spec

operatingHours — copied from Bali's unconfirmed defaults; Bangkok's real business hours have not been provided
dispatch.acceptanceTimeoutMinutes — copied from the Bali/REQ-OPS-TIMEOUT-09 value; unconfirmed whether Bangkok's contractor network needs a different SLA

featureFlags.killSwitch=true and autoDispatchEnabled=false — a deliberate SAFE-BY-DEFAULT choice for an unlaunched market with no confirmed config, not a spec value. Flip only after a human confirms this market is ready for live automated dispatch.
